description: The rows of the Rollupvo dataset where a column equals a value exactly (case-insensitive).

description.name: dataset_compare
description.description: The rows of the Rollupvo dataset whose column is any of the given values, in the order given — for "X vs Y" questions.

description.name: dataset_stats
description.description: count, min, max, mean, median and sum of a numeric column of the Rollupvo dataset (grouping commas and currency are handled; non-numeric rows are excluded and counted).

description.name: dataset_top
description.description: The highest (or lowest) rows of the Rollupvo dataset by a numeric column — "which is the most/least X".

description.name: dataset_provenance
description.description: The source, the date it was computed, the licence and the citation for the Rollupvo dataset. Read this to attribute a figure correctly.
